about: OmniOS Universe v7: 1,500 items genuinely sold in Indian kirana / supermarts / regional markets / pharmacy-lite / stationery / hardware-lite / pooja / baby / pet. Pack sizes and flavours are variants (one default per item = the most common Indian size + flavour); no flavour is ever dropped (v7 restored every v5 flavour removed in v6). Used by voice + receipt matching. Old pack-size items merged into variants keep their ids as variant `legacy`. Merges with catalog.json.
